svg.title: A flow as a tool of an agent: the contract
svg.desc: From left to right. Sami asks the agent Cedar Dispatch Helper: what is the status of WO-1002? The agent's orchestrator, a language model, reads the names and descriptions of its tools, chooses the tool Work order status and fills the input WorkOrderNumber with text it extracted. The flow starts with the trigger When an agent calls the flow, normalises and validates the text, queries Dataverse with a fixed identity (Cedar Automation) and a fixed list of columns, and answers with Respond to the agent: a result word, named fields and a message. The agent turns the fields into a sentence. Four requirements from the documentation are listed under the arrow: the trigger and the response action, a real-time response with the asynchronous toggle off, the flow published, and an answer within 100 seconds. Below, two columns. What the model decides: whether to call the tool, what text to pass, how to phrase the answer. What the flow decides: what counts as a valid number, which identity reads, which columns exist in the answer, what each result word means, what happens on failure. A bottom line: treat the input as text from outside, and the output as text that a model will repeat to a person.
svg.text: The model chooses and phrases; the flow decides what is true and what is allowed
picks a tool, fills its inputs,
When an agent calls the flow
Required for a flow to be a tool (Copilot Studio documentation, June 2026)
Trigger “When an agent calls the flow” and action “Respond to the agent” · real-time response (Asynchronous response Off)
· published · answers within the 100-second action limit
Whether this tool fits the question
What text to put into WorkOrderNumber
How to phrase the fields as an answer
So: descriptions matter as much as code, and the
same question may be handled differently twice.
What a valid work order number is
Which identity reads, and which columns exist
So: the same input always gives the same output,
and it can be tested without any model.
Input = text from outside (validate it). Output = text a model will repeat to a person (shape it; no whole rows, no denied columns).
